need: Public Tây Sơn pages must inherit the approved landing-page visual system and the frontend skill runtime must explicitly require complete, purposeful Framer Motion coverage for landing surfaces.
negativeBoundary: Do not replace the landing authority with giant editorial-serif compositions, animate layout in a way that causes shifts or delays access, ignore reduced-motion preferences, or impose landing animation requirements on unrelated operational CRM surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Giới thiệu, Hội viên, and Tin tức & Hoạt động use the landing page's sans typography, header, spacing rhythm, grid language, controls, and restrained green palette.
The landing page and its public consumers use Framer Motion for purposeful hero, section, staggered content, and interactive feedback instead of isolated decorative animation.
All motion preserves layout stability and has a deterministic prefers-reduced-motion path.
The owning .claude frontend surface skill explicitly requires landing motion coverage and proof in its acceptance matrix.

The three featured members on the landing page are selected from the same database-backed approved-member source as the public directory, with explicit loading, empty, and error states and no fabricated business fallback.
Desktop, tablet, and mobile screenshots and browser interaction checks prove visual continuity across the four public routes.
Every public child-page masthead uses a restrained display scale and an image-bearing composition derived from the landing authority instead of an oversized text-only viewport.
Directory, article, and detail content regions use the full available desktop content width; no primary data list is arbitrarily constrained to half of its section.
All public routes reachable from the landing navigation and their public detail consumers share the same responsive spacing, media treatment, typography hierarchy, and motion primitives.

accepts: Treat the current landing page as the smallest visual authority for all public Tây Sơn routes.
Require and implement full purposeful Framer Motion coverage, especially for the landing page.
Update the owning .claude skill contract and add a regression check for the landing motion requirement.
rejects: Keep oversized serif hero treatments that make child pages look like a different product.
Add disconnected one-off animations without shared motion primitives or reduced-motion handling.
Apply landing animation rules to the operational CRM workspace.

accepts: Populate the landing-page member preview from the approved-member API used by the public directory.

rejects: Keep Công ty TNHH Sản xuất An Phát, Hợp tác xã Nông nghiệp Phú Phong, or Doanh nghiệp Dịch vụ Minh Long as hardcoded display data.
